name: Energy Access and Inclusive Development
description: Fundamental difference between energy, energy access and security, the critical role of electricity and clean cooking fuels for development. Principles of inclusive energy access, with emphasis on gender, democratization, socio-economic and cultural factors influencing communities. Global frameworks like UNDP’s sustainable energy for all, new age energy access tools coupling climate change adaptation strategies. National and international policies, regulation, and financing mechanisms to strengthen energy access and the best practices from across the globe.
